description: Jan Evertsenstraat 139-149 odd and 146-156 even, west of the Mercatorplein (1926-27): brown brick, two storeys of three two-light casements over a residential ground (paired doors), a white-painted continuous window band as the top storey (white piers between six lights), a white band at the ground-storey top, under a pitched tiled roof

balconyRun.evidence: strip.jpg 2024-12-06 of 147 (evertsen-145-155): the brick balcony front 3.4-4.45 m over a slab shadow 3.25-3.4 m along the whole front; the 0.5 m depth is not measurable on the ortho strip

tile-roof.note: the pitched tiled roof rising from the white band (12.6-15.0 m on 141); the roof itself is 3DBAG's

raised-end.note: raised stair-tower ends at 143, 145, 150, 152: a module of their own (one window per storey, a fifth storey, 2.2 m of plain brick to the coping at 17.4 m on 143)

paired-doors.note: 141, 148: a pair of house doors at one end, windows beside them

windows.note: 139: windows only on this front (the doors are on the neighbour's side)

rhythm.bays: 3 axes on the brick storeys, 6 lights in the white top band
rhythm.windowsPerStorey: ground: doors + windows | 1-2: 3 | 3: 6 in the white band
rhythm.roofline: white band storey under a pitched tile roof
schemaLimits: the white attic band is painted timber; drawn as white painted bands and piers over brick
the balcony depth (0.5 m) is not measurable on the ortho strip

evidence.citation: strip.jpg 2024-12-06, ruler crop of 141: white line at the ground-storey top 3.15-3.4 m, windows 4.0-5.3 and 7.25-8.85 m, white band 9.6-12.6 m with lights 10.9-12.3 m between white piers, tiles 12.6-15.0 m; storeys 3.2/3.1/3.2/3.0 m; palette-from-strip band rows 9.45-9.55, 10.55-11.85, 12.47-12.5 m

strip.jpg 2024-12-06, ruler crop (104 px/m) of 141: six lights between white piers in the top band (10.4-12.6 m), not five; ground windows 0.15-1.3 and 2.25-3.35 m and the paired doors 4.1-6.0 m (three ground openings); storey windows 0.2-1.35, 2.35-3.45, 4.5-5.6 m; a white ledge 9.45-9.65 m under the band storey and the balcony ledge 3.2-3.5 m with an iron rail along storey 1

strip.jpg 2024-12-06, column profile of the pier at 1.5-2.2 m on 141 (vprofile.mjs): white slab edge 3.15-3.45 m, iron rail to 4.4 m, white ledge 9.35-9.6 m over a shadow, brick 9.6-10.3 m, the white band 10.3-12.1 m, shadow 12.2-12.35 m, white cornice 12.35-12.65 m; storeys 3.45/2.95/2.95/2.78 m to 12.13 m under the cornice; windows 1.1-2.8 / 4.3-5.8 / 7.3-8.9 m, band lights 10.6-12.0 m
strip.jpg 2024-12-06: 148, white band rows 10.75-11.85 m, the same body
strip.jpg 2024-12-06: 154, the same body (tree over the uppers on 152/158)
palette over the type's 12 pands (de-baarsjes-palettes.ts): wall #5a4c39, frames #abac96, white band #b2b39c (151275's band median, n=2 type-wide #b8b9a7)

notes: Placed on evertsen-139-143, -145-155, -146-150 and -152-160 (lane de-baarsjes-faces-20261016); mirror: true puts the paired doors at the left.
The raised stair-tower ends (143, 145, 150, 152) are raised-end modules with their own window axes.
